title: Letter and Typewriter
author: Beatrix Ishikawa
blurb: Silas Underhill, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
